company_name.description: Name of the presenting company as printed in its logo or text, e.g. 'NAVER'

presentation_title.description: Title on the cover slide, in Korean as printed (e.g. 2026년도 3분기 실적발표)

presentation_date.description: Date on the cover slide, as YYYY-MM-DD

reporting_period.description: The quarter the results cover, as written in the column headers, e.g. '3Q26'

accounting_basis.description: The accounting standard the figures are prepared under, from the 유의 사항 (disclaimer) slide, e.g. 'K-IFRS'

currency_unit.description: The unit stated on the results summary table (단위), in Korean as printed, e.g. '십억 원'

revenue.description: 매출액 (revenue) — row of the 실적요약 (results summary) table on the summary slide

q3_2026.description: Value in the 3Q26 column, in billions of KRW (십억 원), as a number

q3_2025.description: Value in the 3Q25 column (the same quarter a year earlier), in billions of KRW (십억 원), as a number

yoy_change.description: The Y/Y column for this row, exactly as printed, e.g. '10.7%'

qoq_change.description: The Q/Q column for this row, exactly as printed, e.g. '2.5%'

operating_expenses.description: 영업비용 (operating expenses) — row of the 실적요약 (results summary) table on the summary slide

q3_2026.description: Value in the 3Q26 column, in billions of KRW (십억 원), as a number

q3_2025.description: Value in the 3Q25 column (the same quarter a year earlier), in billions of KRW (십억 원), as a number

yoy_change.description: The Y/Y column for this row, exactly as printed, e.g. '10.7%'

qoq_change.description: The Q/Q column for this row, exactly as printed, e.g. '2.5%'

operating_profit.description: 영업이익 (operating profit) — row of the 실적요약 (results summary) table on the summary slide

q3_2026.description: Value in the 3Q26 column, in billions of KRW (십억 원), as a number

q3_2025.description: Value in the 3Q25 column (the same quarter a year earlier), in billions of KRW (십억 원), as a number

yoy_change.description: The Y/Y column for this row, exactly as printed, e.g. '10.7%'

qoq_change.description: The Q/Q column for this row, exactly as printed, e.g. '2.5%'

net_income.description: 당기순이익 (net income) — row of the 실적요약 (results summary) table on the summary slide

q3_2026.description: Value in the 3Q26 column, in billions of KRW (십억 원), as a number

q3_2025.description: Value in the 3Q25 column (the same quarter a year earlier), in billions of KRW (십억 원), as a number

yoy_change.description: The Y/Y column for this row, exactly as printed, e.g. '10.7%'

qoq_change.description: The Q/Q column for this row, exactly as printed, e.g. '2.5%'

operating_margin_percent.description: 영업이익률 (operating margin) for 3Q26, as a number, e.g. 13.0

revenue_growth_excluding_acquisition.description: The footnote's revenue growth excluding the 왈라팝 (Wallapop) acquisition, as printed in Korean, including both YoY and QoQ figures

segment_revenue_3q26.description: 3Q26 revenue for each business segment and sub-segment row in the results summary table (네이버 플랫폼, 광고, 서비스, 파이낸셜 플랫폼, 글로벌 도전, C2C, 콘텐츠, 엔터프라이즈)

segment.description: Segment name in Korean, as printed

revenue.description: 3Q26 revenue in billions of KRW (십억 원)

total_payment_volume_trillion_krw.description: 3Q26 결제액 (TPV, total payment volume) in trillions of KRW (조 원), as a number

tpv_yoy_growth.description: YoY growth of total payment volume, as printed in the bullets, e.g. '15.6%'

external_tpv_yoy_growth.description: YoY growth of 외부 결제액 (external payment volume), as printed in the bullets

operating_costs.description: The 비용/손익 (costs and profit) slide, 3Q26 column, in billions of KRW (십억 원)

marketing_yoy_change.description: Y/Y change of marketing costs as printed, e.g. '32.3%'

cash_and_borrowings.description: The 현금 및 차입금 현황 (cash and borrowings) tables, 3Q26 column, in billions of KRW (십억 원)

cash_separate.description: 별도 (separate / parent-only) cash, cash equivalents and short-term financial instruments in 3Q26

cash_consolidated.description: 연결 (consolidated) cash, cash equivalents and short-term financial instruments in 3Q26

non_operating.description: The Appendix 당기순이익 주요 증감내역 (net income bridge) slide, 3Q26 column, in billions of KRW (십억 원)

non_operating_income.description: 영업외손익 (non-operating income) in 3Q26; negative if a loss

financial_income.description: 금융손익 (financial income) in 3Q26; negative if a loss
